tokenizer.identity: LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Base tokenizer at the same pinned revision
tokenizer.mode: fast tokenizer with offset_mapping; do not load the LFM model during tokenizer alignment qualification
tokenizer.offset_unit: character offsets into the exact ASCII input; ASCII restriction makes byte and character offsets identical
tokenizer.special_tokens: record all token IDs and offset mappings; offsets (0,0) are non-source model-visible positions and are excluded from span means
tokenizer.ambiguity_rejection: For each recorded half-open source span, the union of overlapping nonspecial token offsets must cover every source character exactly once; no selected token may cross a span boundary, no gap or overlap is accepted, and the selected token positions must be nonempty. Reject the row before model forward on failure and report counts by span type and template.

input.source: only the sealed S01-2 counterfactual-quartet corpus
input.input_layout: exactly the serialized input_text bytes; tokenizer special tokens according to the pinned tokenizer; no added prompt, truncation, padding, or batching
input.execution: single row, exact tokenized length, no padding, no mixed-length batches

hidden_state: final transformer layer, frozen model, float32 serialized output; read-only forward pass

representation_views.rule: arithmetic mean of final-layer hidden states at every model-visible position, including special-token positions
final-layer hidden state at token position sequence_length-1
final-layer hidden state at token position 0 of the exact tokenizer output, including a leading BOS token when the pinned tokenizer emits one
mean final-layer hidden state over the deduplicated nonspecial token positions aligned to every context-term occurrence
mean final-layer hidden state over the deduplicated nonspecial token positions aligned to every entity-term occurrence
mean final-layer hidden state over the deduplicated nonspecial token positions aligned to every relation occurrence
concatenate V3, V4, V5 in that order without projection or normalization

serialization.base_views: V0..V5 are 2048 float32 values per input; V6 is 6144 float32 values per input
serialization.cache: new S01-2-only cache with its own manifests, hashes, receipts, and seal; no parent cache reuse

determinism: Repeat a prospectively fixed sample of 256 events, one row at a time. Token IDs, offsets, shapes, and feature bytes must match exactly; any mismatch fails closed.
